adapterSetup: Fresh unauthenticated scenario with deterministic identity, reference products and providers.
userActions: Open protected CRM deep link; sign in through the login form.
Use sidebar Customer intake; create customer and property.
Use sidebar Quotes and policies; create quote, bind and open policy detail.
Record finance event through visible controls; log out; revisit protected route.
visibleAssertions: Login form and restored Quotes and policies heading.
Customer and property appear in accessible intake controls.
Bound policy detail and finance transaction are visible.
Protected revisit shows login and no protected content.
persistedInvariants: After final visible outcome, query exactly one customer/property/quote/bound policy and matching policy-state and finance entries.

adapterSetup: Fresh authenticated scenario with one-shot accepted-bind response loss or pending delivery fault.
userActions: Create and bind a quote through the UI.
Observe disabled competing actions; check status or retry; open resulting policy.
visibleAssertions: Recoverable command status and disabled competing actions.
Final bound policy and initialized finance are visible.
persistedInvariants: After visible success, query exactly one policy, projection and ledger initialization for the command.

adapterSetup: Fresh authenticated scenario with a role denied CRM access.
userActions: Inspect sidebar and attempt protected CRM direct route.
visibleAssertions: Restricted navigation absent; direct access shows accessible denial.
persistedInvariants: After denial, inspect request log: no protected API command issued.

adapterSetup: One fresh scenario runtime; two independently authenticated BrowserContexts with distinct tenant memberships.
userActions: Each tenant creates intake, quote, bind and finance state through visible controls.
Attempt foreign resource routes and exercise a pending retry in its owning context.
visibleAssertions: Customer, quote, policy, ledger and retry state are visible only to the owning tenant.
Foreign resources display denial without tenant data.
persistedInvariants: After visible outcomes, contract reads and mutation attempts deny cross-tenant customer, quote, policy, ledger and retry access.

persistedInvariants: Service and contract tests preserve cancellation lifecycle, allocated refund corrections, and append-only commission payment evidence.
